senses.gloss:
रेत = रेतस्, semen virile.
—रेत-ज, अस्, आ, अम्,
born or produced from seed; any beloved offspring
or child; (आ), f. sand.

रेतस् रेतस्, अस्, n. (fr. rt. 1. री), a flow, flood,
stream, current, flow of water or rain (Ved.); flow of
semen, seminal fluid, semen, sperm, virile energy;
seed, offspring, progeny, posterity, descendants (Ved.);
quicksilver (regarded as ‘Śiva's semen’); sin, (Sāy.
on Ṛg-veda IV. 3, 7 = पाप.)
—रेतः-कुल्या, f.
a stream or river of semen virile (in a particular hell).
—रेतः-सिच्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. discharging semen; an
epithet of particular Iṣṭakās.
—रेतः-सिच्य, अम्,
n., Ved. discharge of semen.
—रेतस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
Ved. possessed of seed, abounding in seed, impregnat-
ing, prolific, productive; (आन्), m. epithet of Agni.
—रेतस्-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. abounding in seed, pro-
lific, productive.
—रेतो-धा, आस्, f., Ved. the act of
impregnating, impregnation; (आस्, आस्, अम्), impreg-
nating, fertilizing; (आस्), m. a father.
—रेतो-धेय,
अम्, n., Ved. impregnation.
—रेतो-मार्ग, अस्, m.
the seminal duct or canal.

रेतस at the end of a comp. = रेतस्; [cf. अग्नि-
र्˚, कपोत-र्˚.]

रेतस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. conveying seed, (the first
verse of the Bahiṣpavamāna Stotra is so called.)

रेतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. abounding in seed; impreg-
nating.

रेत्र, अम्, n. semen virile; quicksilver; nectar,
ambrosia; perfumed or aromatic powder; (these
meanings are sometimes given to वेत्र, which is
confounded with रेत्र.)
